title: Soft & Smooth Face Cream with Sun Protection

details.description: White Tone Face Cream offers comprehensive care with hydrating sun protection, ensuring your skin stays radiant and glowing throughout the day. This all-day usage cream effectively cleanses skin pores, promoting fairness and skin lightening for a more even complexion. Perfect for daily care, it provides essential moisturisation and nourishment, leaving your skin soft and supple. The cream's unique formula is designed to hydrate while protecting your skin from harmful UV rays, making it an ideal addition to your skincare routine. Regular use helps in achieving a luminous and youthful glow, while also improving overall skin texture. Enjoy the benefits of White Tone Face Cream and embrace a brighter, healthier-looking complexion every day.
details.usageInstructions: 1. Apply White Tone Face Cream as and when required.
details.storageInstructions: *Store in a cool and dry place

details.description: Indulge in the captivating allure of this Fogg PearlFace Powder, a true gem for fair-skinned beauties. Infused with a sweet, floral fragrance that is both delicate and long-lasting, this powder effortlessly mattifies combination skin, leaving a smooth, even-toned complexion. Its lightweight, silky texture glides on seamlessly, minimising the appearance of minor blemishes and imparting a radiant, natural-looking glow. Enriched with nourishing ingredients, this powder absorbs excess oil, keeping the T-zone shine-free for up to two hours. Elevate your makeup routine with this versatile face powder that brightens, mattifies, and leaves your skin feeling refreshed and soft throughout the day.

Fogg PearlFace Powder offers a smooth, matte finish that minimizes the appearance of minor blemishes, creating a natural, flawless look. Infused with a refreshing, long-lasting fragrance, this lightweight powder provides a soothing experience throughout the day. The mattifying formula helps control excess oil secretion, leaving your skin looking brighter and more even-toned. With a soft, silky texture, the powder blends seamlessly for a natural, oil-free finish that keeps your skin feeling soft and smooth. Whether you're looking to even out minor imperfections or achieve a radiant, glowing complexion, Fogg PearlFace Powder is the perfect addition to your beauty routine.
